name: Venture OS — Capture
description: Capture the LinkedIn profile you are viewing into Venture OS. Reads a page when you ask it to — from the popup, or when Venture OS requests one. Never posts, messages or acts for you.
_comment_host_permissions: linkedin.com so the passive observer can be DECLARED at document_start — a dynamically registered script cannot reliably beat the page's own scripts, and the interceptor must patch fetch before the first request. media.licdn.com so the SERVICE WORKER can retrieve avatar bytes: those URLs are signed and refuse both an unauthenticated server fetch and a cross-origin page fetch. NO cookies, NO webRequest, NO declarativeNetRequest — the extension never issues a request to LinkedIn and never reads a credential.
